paragraphs.text: Software engineer with 7 years of experience in development of complex software applications and a master's degree in Computer Science. Certified AWS developer.
As a Senior Engineer, I drive the full development lifecycle — including planning, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
Develop high-loaded applications for the network monitoring systems, using Java applications
Using asynchronous programming tools: event-based ﬂows, reactive programming, task queues, message queue (Kafka)
Deploy applications to cloud using GitOps approach
Containerization and orchestration of applications using Kubernetes and Helm

Containers: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), Kubernetes, Docker
